name: ModelVariant101_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant101_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (textured rings trail behind the configured joints and fade out, then flashes and bursts of sparks spin open in front of the model); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, clears the 128 trail points and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first burst, 4 while the bursts run, 1 once after the last burst and 2 after that; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-118 and 248 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
